environment.description: Rails 7.1 application deployed on EKS (Kubernetes 1.29) with the pod configured to use AWS CloudHSM Client SDK 5.9 via PKCS#11 provider. The libcrypto_bridge.so is recompiled to use the CloudHSM PKCS#11 interface (C_Decrypt, C_Sign, C_DeriveKey) rather than loading raw key bytes. The HSM's PKCS#11 session returns CKR_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL if the output buffer is undersized, and key handles are opaque CK_OBJECT_HANDLE values (8-byte integers) — the actual key material never transits to the application process memory. The native decrypt_payload function's internal 256-byte stack buffer is used only to hold the CK_OBJECT_HANDLE (8 bytes) plus a CK_MECHANISM struct (16 bytes), never raw key material. Pod runs with seccomp profile 'runtime/default' and a read-only root filesystem. Node-level IMDSv2 enforcement with hop limit 1.
